keyDecisions: Unified interface: all providers reduce to {model, apiKey?, endpoint?}
API keys stay in Electron safeStorage (already generic)
Searchable categorized provider switcher with Cmd+P shortcut
Only active provider shows expanded config
New provider cost: 1 definition entry + 1 implementation file (~40 lines)
ProviderEngine class replaces switch statement in orchestrator
phaseOrder: Phase 1: Foundation - create registry, refactor existing providers
Phase 3: UI redesign - searchable switcher + dynamic cards
Phase 4: Polish - recently used, configured badges, OpenRouter mode
